faqs.question: How does live preview work in this HTML editor?
faqs.answer: As you type HTML tags, CSS stylesheets, or JavaScript code, the built-in renderer instantly compiles and displays the output in the synchronized live frame.

faqs.question: Can I test responsive mobile views?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can toggle between Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile viewport modes to test how your layout behaves on different screen widths.

faqs.question: Can I include external CSS and JavaScript CDN libraries?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can insert <link> or <script> tags for frameworks like Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, FontAwesome, or Google Fonts directly into the head.

faqs.question: Can I download the HTML file?
faqs.answer: Yes, clicking the Download button saves a standalone index.html file containing all your code ready to host on any web server.

faqs.question: Is my HTML/CSS/JS code stored on a server?
faqs.answer: No. The preview frame is rendered directly in memory via your browser's native rendering engine. No data is stored externally.

faqs.question: Can the preview iframe affect or steal data from the parent website?
faqs.answer: No. The preview operates inside an isolated <iframe> with strict sandbox protections that block access to parent window cookies and storage.

faqs.question: Can I include external CDN libraries (e.g., FontAwesome, Google Fonts)?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can link external CSS stylesheets and fonts via standard <link> tags in the HTML header.

faqs.question: How can I save my project?
faqs.answer: Click the Download button to receive a self-contained index.html file that includes all HTML, styles, and scripts ready for deployment.

faqs.question: How does live preview work in this HTML editor?
faqs.answer: As you type HTML tags, CSS stylesheets, or JavaScript code, the built-in renderer instantly compiles and displays the output in the synchronized live frame.

faqs.question: Can I test responsive mobile views?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can toggle between Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile viewport modes to test how your layout behaves on different screen widths.

faqs.question: Can I include external CSS and JavaScript CDN libraries?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can insert <link> or <script> tags for frameworks like Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, FontAwesome, or Google Fonts directly into the head.

faqs.question: Can I download the HTML file?
faqs.answer: Yes, clicking the Download button saves a standalone index.html file containing all your code ready to host on any web server.

faqs.question: O código fica gravado em algum servidor?
faqs.answer: Não. A pré-visualização é gerada exclusivamente na memória do navegador.

faqs.question: O iframe de teste tem acesso à página externa?
faqs.answer: Não. Ele é protegido por regras de sandbox que isolam completamente a execução.

faqs.question: É possível vincular fontes do Google Fonts?
faqs.answer: Sim. Basta adicionar tags <link> padrão no cabeçalho HTML do código.

faqs.question: Como baixar o projeto final?
faqs.answer: Clique no botão Baixar para obter um arquivo index.html completo e funcional.
